subject.why: The lemonade stand is instantly recognizable with all required parts: wooden counter, yellow-and-white striped awning, lemon decoration, pitcher, and cups.

category.why: The stand is framed from a low heroic angle with a ground strip at the bottom and a bright blue sky with volumetric clouds along the horizon.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, logos, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The stand is centered with good breathing room at the top and sides.

colour.why: Bright, warm, saturated palette with strong separation between the yellow stand and the blue sky.

detail.why: The crate of lemons on the right is an extra prop not allowed by the brief, and the individual modeled grass blades create busy micro-detail.

style.why: Renders with smooth, chunky stylized volumes and a soft satin sheen matching the reference cards.

fix: Remove the extra crate of lemons and simplify the spiky grass into a smooth, stylized ground strip.
